verses.english: “Mendicants, for insight into greed, seven things should be developed.

verses.pali: Asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, āhāre paṭikūlasaññā, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā, aniccasaññā, anicce dukkhasaññā, dukkhe anattasaññā—
verses.english: The perceptions of ugliness, death, repulsiveness of food, dissatisfaction with the whole world, impermanence, suffering in impermanence, and not-self in suffering.

verses.pali: rāgassa, bhikkhave, abhiññāya ime satta dhammā bhāvetabbā”ti.
verses.english: These seven things should be developed for insight into greed.”
